Hi Priyom & Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the throughput and the routing options. We pulled procurement into our planning and there are a couple of constraints that will push the acceptance window later than we expected. High level: our security review is on track but vendor onboarding (finance + legal + internal security signoffs) will now complete on the week of Dec 15, which means go-live / final acceptance will be a staggered window beginning Dec 22 and stretching into early Jan for the final integrations.

We still want to proceed and are trying to avoid a hard delay to the PO, but this shift means we need a short MAP update to capture the staggered acceptance and to confirm what we can ship earlier vs. later. Can you send a revised MAP showing:
- staged acceptance dates (feature A on Dec 22, feature B on Jan 5)
- verification criteria for each stage
- any procurement gating items that would block stage 1

I've attached our internal procurement timeline for visibility.

Attachments: [Attachment: ProcurementTimeline_ACME.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

Looping in a quick internal note —

Thanks for the swift turnaround on the MAP draft, Priyom. I reviewed MAP_v3 and the risk-log. Short summary and recommended next steps:

- Risk: Procurement gating currently flags two items that will block invoice processing: (1) Acme requires a data-processing addendum signed by legal (ETA Dec 12) and (2) finance requires vendor tax documents (ETA Dec 10). Both are in the procurement packet Sarah sent.
- Impact: If both are delayed, invoice activation is delayed and we cannot enable metering/billing for stage 1.
- Mitigation: Recommend we split the acceptance into three lanes rather than two:
   * Lane 1 (Dec 22): Feature A (read-only + monitoring + internal users) — no billing required.
   * Lane 2 (Jan 5): Feature B (customer-facing inference + model routing) — billing enabled if finance clears.
   * Lane 3 (Jan 12): Final integration and acceptance once legal signoff complete.
- Escalation: If the legal DPA slips past Dec 19 we should route to GTM execs for an exception to accept alternative contract terms (short-term bridge).

I'll prepare an internal one-pager and a short executive note we can include in the customer-facing MAP. Recommend we mark the MAP as 'provisional' and include the gating checklist.

Laura
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
